# Hubber, a Month of Content in One Day for $1,500

> Hubber is a video production company serving businesses in the Greater Orlando area, Florida. It plans, scripts, films and edits a full month of content, up to 30 vertical videos, from a single shoot day at the client's location. Hubber is part of the Cinnamon Group.

## Offer

- One-time content shoot: $1,500. A month of custom scripts, one on-site recording session, professional on-camera direction, up to 30 fully edited videos, ready-to-post vertical delivery, no monthly commitment. Booking through the page adds custom covers for every video at no additional cost.

## How it works

- Planning: Hubber studies the client's business, audience, services and communication goals, then writes twelve scripts the client approves before filming.
- Filming: one organized recording session at the client's business or an approved location in the Greater Orlando area, with on-camera direction throughout.
- Delivery: the footage becomes a full month of edited videos (up to 30) with captions, audio treatment, color correction and social-first pacing, sized for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube Shorts.
